briefing.summary: At the holding point for runway 29R. Checks complete, ready for departure. Awaiting line-up instruction.

challenge.prompt: Make the call to Bankstown Tower advising you're ready for departure.
challenge.expectedText: Bankstown Tower, Lima Echo Foxtrot, holding point runway two nine right, ready.

elements.label: Position
accept: holding point runway two nine right
elements.hint: State your position at the holding point with runway designation.

challenge.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4: tell Tower where you are and that you're ready. Don't say 'request take-off' — Tower decides when, you announce readiness.
